title: Nearest airborne aircraft
tooltip.aircraft: %1 · %2 · %3. Click for details and tracking links.
state.configure: Set your home location below. No aircraft requests have been made.
state.loading: Waiting for a fresh aircraft report. A previous rate-limit cooldown may still apply.
state.paused: Aircraft polling is paused. Resume when you want it back.
state.stale: The last position is too old. It is not shown as the current nearest aircraft.
state.empty: No fresh airborne aircraft found within your selected range.
state.offline: The feed is unavailable. Requests will back off, then stop after three failures.
state.blocked: Automatic requests stopped after a provider restriction or repeated failures. Retry respects the provider cooldown.
state.error: The local helper stopped or needs attention. Disable the widget until its state is checked.
identity.airline: Airline-code format derived from the broadcast callsign. The booked or codeshare flight number is not independently confirmed.
identity.tail: Tail number preferred for GA and military aircraft.
identity.callsign: Broadcast callsign shown because a reliable public flight number or tail was not available.
identity.hex: ICAO/contact identifier shown because a tail number and callsign were unavailable.
links.note: Tracking links open in your default browser. FR24 uses the public aircraft page where a tail is known; ADS-B Exchange selects the ICAO contact where supported.
coverage: Nearest fresh aircraft reported by the feed, measured horizontally. Civil, military and unclassified traffic are eligible; coverage is incomplete.
home.title: Home location · stored locally
home.instructions: Enter decimal latitude and longitude from your own map pin. No address lookup is performed.
home.privacy: Exact coordinates stay in a private local file. ADSB.fi receives a search centre rounded to 0.1°. Save starts one request every ten seconds while this widget is enabled.
home.error: Enter valid numeric coordinates. Latitude must be between -90 and 90; longitude between -180 and 180. If saving still fails, check the local state permissions.
range.label: Search range
range.hint: 1–100 miles from your saved location. Also available in widget settings.
range.saveError: Could not save the range. Try again or check Omarchy widget settings.
range.error: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100 miles.
